newsitem.title: USA: Harvard says to be delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Harvard says to be delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: Harvard Industries Inc, a producer of automotive parts and accessories, said Thursday that its common stock is scheduled to be delisted from The Nasdaq stock market, effective with the close of business on Friday, March 14.
The company said it was being delisted because of its inability to maintain the listing standards of The Nasdaq Stock Market.
